description: John has a 300 acre berry farm on which to plant blueberries and raspberries. John has $10000 to spend on watering and 575 days worth of labor available. For each acre of blueberries, 6 days worth of labor and $22 in watering costs is required. For each acre of raspberries, 3 days worth of labor and $25 in watering costs is required. The profit per acre of blueberries is $56 and the profit per acre of raspberries is $75. Formulate an LP problem in order to maximize profit.

TotalFarmArea.definition: Total area of the farm in acres

TotalWateringBudget.definition: Total budget available for watering in dollars

NumCrops.definition: Number of different crops to be planted

LaborPerAcre.definition: Amount of labor required per acre for each crop in days

WateringCostPerAcre.definition: Watering cost per acre for each crop in dollars

ProfitPerAcre.definition: Profit per acre for each crop in dollars

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from planting blueberries and raspberries on the farm"
